name: aptmatch-projects
description: AptMatch 求职端与招聘端独立项目编排器

scripts.dev: concurrently -n jobseeker,recruiter -c green,cyan "npm --prefix jobseeker run dev" "npm --prefix recruiter run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix jobseeker run build && npm --prefix recruiter run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix jobseeker test && npm --prefix recruiter test
scripts.start: concurrently -n job-api,recruit-api -c green,cyan "npm --prefix jobseeker start" "npm --prefix recruiter start"
